latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — easily convert video files like AVI, MOV, MKV, WebM to MP4 in seconds, no software needed.

- Supports uploads up to 500MB; output defaults to 1080p MP4.
- Seamless cloud-based conversion, returns download links within 20–40 seconds.
- Anonymous users get 100 free credits for 7 days; automatic token/session handling.
- Friendly error messages for unsupported formats, file size limits, or plan issues.
- Simple prompts trigger conversions, exports, or show status and credits.
- Designed for everyday users—no editing experience required.
